### Do You Have Enough?
Author: Karen Ehman
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/do-you-have-enough-encouragement-for-today-august-19-2013.html
Passage: Luke 12:15
Points:
- Life's timer can run out at any moment, leaving all accumulated earthly goods behind.
- Greed frequently enters daily life through small, justifiable splurges and unnecessary retail desires.
- Personal worth and true living are never defined by the abundance of our material things.
- Believers are called to examine their spending and curb cravings for nonessential items.
- Money saved from restraining selfish desires should be used to bless others and meet needs.

### The Parable of the Rich Fool
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/parable-rich-fool
Passage: Luke 12:13-21
Points:
- Jesus bypassed a family inheritance dispute to address the root sin of covetousness.
- The rich farmer pursued complete self-sufficiency rather than living in dependence on God.
- Wealth itself is not condemned, but serving riches as an idol brings divine judgment.
- Failing to thank God for abundance inevitably leads to hoarding rather than generosity toward the poor.
- Christians are called to repent of covetousness and steward their resources for the kingdom of God.
